embedding.query_instruction: Retrieve research papers relevant to the described research task.

topics.label: 代码生成与候选选择
queries: Large language models generating and completing source code for programming problems, competitive programming, and functional correctness.
Selecting, ranking, or improving generated program solutions using execution feedback, sampling, and correctness verification.

topics.label: 代码修复与调试
queries: Language models debugging software, locating faults, generating patches, and repairing incorrect programs.
Automated program repair and bug fixing using language models, test failures, and execution feedback.

topics.label: 代码编辑、迁移与审查
queries: Language models editing and modifying existing source code according to natural language instructions, with efficient large and small model collaboration.
Language models translating or migrating programs between programming languages, refactoring code, and generating code review feedback.

topics.label: 单元测试与代码验证
queries: Language models generating unit tests, test cases and test assertions for programs and evaluating the correctness of generated code.
Improving code solution verification and reward signals by generating, selecting, or scaling executable tests.

topics.label: 仓库级任务与 coding agent
queries: Coding agents using tools to solve GitHub issues and repository-level software engineering tasks with planning, search, and iterative feedback.
Language model agents understanding software repositories, generating project implementations, and making coordinated changes across multiple files.

topics.label: 数学解题与推理
queries: Language models solving mathematical problems, arithmetic word problems, competition and olympiad mathematics, and symbolic reasoning.
Improving mathematical problem solving with reasoning search, tool-assisted calculation, and reasoning language models.

topics.label: 推理验证、纠错与效率
queries: Verifying mathematical reasoning steps, detecting errors in solutions, process reward models, self-correction and reasoning critique.
Reducing overthinking and redundant chain-of-thought tokens while maintaining accuracy on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

topics.label: 文本问答与上下文方法
queries: Language models answering text questions with provided passages, multi-hop question answering, retrieval context selection and context compression.
Improving language model question answering and reasoning by learning from mistakes, selecting demonstrations, and refining prompts.

topics.label: 指令遵循与通用文本推理
queries: Evaluating and improving language model instruction following with verifiable constraints and multi-instruction prompts.
Prompting methods, self-reflection, and code-assisted reasoning for text-based reasoning tasks evaluated on BIG-Bench Hard.

topics.label: 提示优化、示例选择与上下文学习
queries: Methods for optimizing prompts and selecting in-context demonstrations to improve language model task performance, learning from feedback and mistakes.
Language model prompt refinement, automatic prompt optimization, demonstration retrieval and context engineering for text reasoning tasks.

topics.label: 推理搜索、自纠错与推理预算
queries: Inference-time methods that improve language model reasoning through search, self-reflection, self-correction, verification and allocating computation budgets.
Language model planning and tree search over candidate reasoning trajectories, combining multiple solution paths and choosing reliable answers.

topics.label: 工具调用与任务型智能体
queries: Language model agents using external tools, function calls and APIs to solve text-based tasks, plan action sequences and learn from execution feedback.
Reliable tool selection, tool invocation and multi-agent cooperation for language model assistants completing practical tasks.

topics.label: 生成程序的效率与资源使用
queries: Improving the execution time, memory use, computational complexity and resource efficiency of programs generated by language models, using profiling, optimization or program transformations.
Language model methods for efficient generated code, with measured runtime and memory feedback, performance bottleneck analysis, and correctness-preserving code optimization.

topics.label: 执行反馈与自检可靠性
queries: Understanding when generated tests, self-debugging, self-correction and execution feedback improve or harm language model code generation, including incorrect tests and changes from correct programs to wrong programs.

Controlled experiments on code model feedback reliability, self-generated test bias, correctness checking, execution traces and repeated refinement, with practical comparisons of inference-time methods.
